test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A government run by a single person
solution: The correct answer is: **Autocracy**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Autocracy **means a system of government by one person with absolute power. (पूर्ण शक्ति वाले एक व्यक्ति द्वारा शासन की प्रणाली) • The word comes from the Greek words '**auto**' meaning '**self**' and '**kratos**' meaning '**power**'. • Autocracy can also be referred to as a dictatorship or a monarchy. • Examples of countries with autocratic governments include North Korea and Saudi Arabia. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Anocracy **refers to a government that is a mix of democratic and autocratic elements. (एक ऐसी सरकार जो लोकतांत्रिक और निरंकुश तत्वों का मिश्रण है) • **Bureaucracy **refers to a system of government in which officials make decisions rather than elected representatives. (सरकार की एक प्रणाली जिसमें निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधियों के बजाय अधिकारी निर्णय लेते हैं) • **Gerontocracy **refers to a government ruled by elderly people. (बुजुर्ग लोगों द्वारा शासित सरकार) 1d9:T8ad, The correct answer is: "**Structrure**".
